data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Mavra was a goddess of the earth, fertility, and abundance. In Christianity, the name Mavra is derived from the Greek word 'mavros,' meaning 'black.' This name can be given to a girl symbolizing the depth and richness of grace and beauty. The name Mavra carries the meaning “Grace, Beauty” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mavra usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
